# concept formation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:learningConceptFormation`](gmeow-learningConceptFormation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/learningConceptFormation>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/learning`](../../slices/learning.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A learning event in which the agent forms a new concept — acquiring a category, schema, or abstraction it did not previously hold. Bridges the forthcoming concepts slice: the concept formed is the gmeow:Concept that slice will define; until then the product rides [`gmeow:produces`](../properties/gmeow-produces.md) with an open range. The bridge is documented routing, not an axiom.
